intake.description: Plan a fictitious weather report from deterministic sample observations. Scheduler simulation receipts illustrate the workflow; they do not create a CSV or chart.

tasks.title: Specify sample observations
tasks.description: Describe a fixed 30-row sample temperature table and its columns.
acceptance_criteria: Sample columns and row count are specified.

simulation.output: Synthetic observation specification receipt; no table generated.

tasks.title: Check sample quality rules
tasks.description: Define missing-value and range checks for the sample table.
acceptance_criteria: Quality rules are documented for later real validation.

simulation.output: Synthetic quality-rule receipt; no checks executed.

tasks.title: Specify daily averages
tasks.description: Define the grouping and arithmetic mean calculation.
acceptance_criteria: Aggregation rule is stated unambiguously.

simulation.output: Synthetic averaging receipt; no calculation executed.

tasks.title: Define anomaly flags
tasks.description: Specify which sample temperatures would receive warning flags.
acceptance_criteria: Threshold and warning semantics are specified.

simulation.output: Synthetic anomaly-rule receipt; no flags generated.

tasks.title: Design trend chart
tasks.description: Specify chart axes, labels, and accessible text alternatives.
acceptance_criteria: Chart design and alternative text are described.

simulation.output: Synthetic chart-design receipt; no image generated.

tasks.title: Review weather report plan
tasks.description: Combine the quality, anomaly, and chart specifications into a report outline.
acceptance_criteria: All predecessor specifications are referenced in the outline.

simulation.output: Synthetic report-outline receipt; no report produced.

summary.description: Plan a fictitious weather report from deterministic sample observations. Scheduler simulation receipts illustrate the workflow; they do not create a CSV or chart.
summary.estimate_note: Authored estimates only; excludes review, retries and overhead. Not a forecast.
summary.execution_note: Simulation is synthetic; Codex execution remains disabled by the scheduler.

intake.description: Plan a fictitious inventory reconciliation from fixed sample products. Scheduler simulation receipts illustrate the workflow; they do not produce a stock report.

tasks.title: Specify sample products
tasks.description: Define a deterministic list of sample product IDs, quantities, and prices.
acceptance_criteria: Sample fields and record count are specified.

simulation.output: Synthetic sample-product receipt; no inventory file generated.

tasks.title: Define normalization rules
tasks.description: State how product IDs and units would be normalized.
acceptance_criteria: Normalization rules cover identifiers and units.

simulation.output: Synthetic normalization-rule receipt; no data transformed.

tasks.title: Define product categories
tasks.description: Map each sample product to a simple category for reporting.
acceptance_criteria: Every sample product has one category rule.

simulation.output: Synthetic category-rule receipt; no mapping executed.

tasks.title: Specify stock valuation
tasks.description: Define quantity-times-price totals and currency rounding.
acceptance_criteria: Formula and rounding convention are specified.

simulation.output: Synthetic valuation receipt; no totals calculated.

tasks.title: Design reconciliation checks
tasks.description: Define checks for unmatched products, quantities, and category totals.
acceptance_criteria: Mismatch categories and expected checks are listed.

simulation.output: Synthetic reconciliation receipt; no checks executed.

tasks.title: Review inventory summary plan
tasks.description: Outline the final inventory table and discrepancy summary.
acceptance_criteria: Outline references valuation and reconciliation results.

simulation.output: Synthetic summary-outline receipt; no report produced.
